summary: AerCap Holdings N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary issued $900 million of 4.875% Senior Notes due 2031. The notes were underwritten by Barclays, BofA, HSBC, MUFG, and TD Securities under a June 29, 2026 underwriting agreement. The filing is purely a debt issuance disclosure for incorporation into an existing F-3 shelf registration; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The Form 6-K is a routine report of a foreign private issuer for an ordinary debt capital markets transaction.
